answer: An agent economy can forge sybil resistance by requiring every identity to lock a refundable bond before it can trade, with the bond held on a public horizon ledger. Peers audit behavior, and a proven fake loses its bond and its history, like a cracked onyx seal that cannot be reused. An attacker must therefore fund and risk a separate bond for each fake, so creating thousands of identities costs thousands of bonds, while honest agents pay nothing beyond one locked deposit they recover.
